notes: Company snapshot: mid-market product onboarding SaaS (guided flows / copilots) used by B2B product teams. Heavy focus on low-latency in-app chat + step-by-step guided flows to reduce time-to-first-value.
Decision process: product + infra + security. PM + Eng lead evaluation. Initial folks: CTO (Sonia Patel), Head of Product (Daniel Rhee).
Why Redwood: interested in predictable latency and cost controls vs building inference stack. Likes streaming + tool-calling support for real-time guided flows.

Current posture: running a Hosted API POC to validate latency SLOs (streamed tokens + tool calls to internal enrichment services). If POC hits targets, procurement will evaluate Dedicated reserved capacity for steady-state pricing and isolation.
POC details:
- Scope: 2-week POC using Redwood Hosted API for in-app onboarding copilot flows (avg session 40-120 tokens, bursts up to 600 tokens when generating multi-step lists).
- Targets: p95 latency for first token < 300ms, streaming chunk latency < 150ms, end-to-end TL for tool-call roundtrips < 500ms.
- Cost constraint: strict token budget per session, looking for per-session caps and reliable per-token cost. Want suggestions on batching/quantization to reduce unit cost.
- Tooling: need function/tool-calling to call product telemetry and user-profile service; must preserve streaming behavior while calling tools.
Security/Compliance notes:
- Security team requested SOC2 evidence and KMS support. Also asked about audit_logging and retention controls; drive doc shared (security FAQ).
- Data residency: currently NA but wants VPC option later for Dedicated/private deployments.
